{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Grotton.png]] |name=Grotton |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{TBB|The Solitary Clone}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Dark brown]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Brown |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Galactic Empire]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Grotton''' was a [[human]] who served as the [[governor]] of [[Desix]] early in the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. When assuming his post, he was held hostage by the unrecognized governor [[Tawni Ames]] after he relieved her, who led the [[planet]] with the aid of her [[Separatist holdouts|Separatist]] [[Desix Separatist holdout|holdout]]. [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] "Cody," [[sniper]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair," and a [[Crosshair and Cody's team|squad]] of [[clone trooper]]s were tasked with [[Mission to Desix|rescuing]] Governor Grotton. After Grotton's rescue, he oversaw planetary leadership. ==Biography== ===Captured by Tawni Ames=== {{Quote|I am here to relieve you of your title, Mistress Ames, by order of the Galactic Empire.''"
"''As I have told your government, Desix does not fall under Imperial jurisdiction. Take your forces and leave peacefully.|Grotton and Tawni Ames|}} [[File:GrottonHoldsHandsUp.png|thumb|left|310px|Grotton surrendered to Tawni Ames and her Separatist holdout.]] Grotton was a young{{TBB|The Solitary Clone}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[human]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire]] after its [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] from the [[Galactic Republic]] in [[19 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' Grotton was appointed to the position of [[governor]] of [[Desix]], a [[planet]] which had aligned itself with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a united breakaway government against the Republic, a [[Democracy|democratic]] [[Politics#Republic|union]] of sovereign [[star system]]s. To enforce Imperial authority over Desix, Grotton and six [[TK stormtrooper]]s were dispatched on a [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]] to a [[Desix City|city]] to instruct the de facto governor, [[Tawni Ames]], to cede control from the independent government to the Empire. While in the planet's [[atmosphere]], a stormtrooper informed Grotton that they were on final approach. After the [[shuttle]] landed, Grotton adjusted his [[Imperial kepi|kepi]] as he stepped out of the ship while being followed by six stormtroopers. They walked to a central building and Grotton looked around, appraising his surroundings. They were approached by Ames who announced her position and told Grotton to state his business. Grotton said that he was there to relieve Ames of her title by order of the Empire. Ames declared that Desix did not fall under Imperial jurisdiction, and she ordered the Imperial to take his forces and leave peacefully. When Grotton refused, Ames summoned several [[B1-series battle droid]]s to surround Grotton's forces. He then raised his [[Limb|hands]] in response to Ames pulling a [[blaster]]. Ames then proclaimed she had a message for the Empire. Grotton was held hostage by the Separatist holdout. To quell this disorder, Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] sent [[Clone Commander]] [[Cody|CC-2224]] "Cody," [[sniper]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair," and a [[Crosshair and Cody's team|squad]] of [[clone trooper]]s to [[Mission to Desix|rescue]] Grotton. Grotton was tied to a chair and guarded by two B1 [[battle droid]]s. He ordered the [[droid]]s to release him, though they refused, stating that the governor had them keep a close [[eye]] on him. Grotton retorted that he was the legitimate governor of Desix before calling the droids scrap heaps. Ames then entered the room, telling Grotton that he would have his freedom when Desix became free, though Grotton declared that the Empire would not agree to her terms. Ames explained how [[Count]] [[Dooku]] correctly predicted that the Republic would become something worse, and Grotton claimed that she would lose the war. ===Rescue mission=== {{Quote|Nicely handled. Now execute her.''"
"''Sir, I promised a peaceful--''"
"''You did. I didn't. Now execute her!|Grotton and Cody, referring to Tawni Ames|}} [[File:TawniAmesHoldsGrottonHostage.png|thumb|right|300px|Tawni Ames holding Grotton hostage]] The [[squad]] of [[Cloning|clone]] [[trooper]]s were shot down but managed to infiltrate the [[city]] and eliminate Ames' battle droids. Cody and Crosshair then entered the [[Desix Bell Tower|bell tower]] where they found Ames holding Grotton hostage at gunpoint. Grotton yelled at the clones to do something as he struggled to escape. Cody convinced Ames to release him and end the conflict without [[blood]]shed. After being released, Grotton ordered Cody to [[Death|execute]] Ames. Cody hesitated, prompting Grotton to angrily repeat his order. Cody continued to hesitate until Ames was shot by Crosshair. Grotton ordered the clones to put Ames' body in the [[City square|square]] as a warning to the people of Desix. He then walked away before being followed by Crosshair. With the rebellion crushed, Grotton oversaw the arrival of more Imperial troopers and the occupation of the city. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I am the legitimate governor of Desix, you scrap heap!|Grotton, to a B1-series battle droid|}} Grotton viewed himself as the legitimate governor of Desix, and he was angered by anyone saying he was not. He could be commanding as shown when he ordered Ames to relinquish her title and ordered Cody to execute her. He was willing to surrender when he knew he was outmatched. He expressed fear when he was surrounded by battle droids and held at gunpoint by Ames. ==Equipment== Grotton wore a [[Color|gray]] [[Imperial military uniforms|Imperial military uniform]] with an Imperial Kepi, two [[code cylinder]]s, and a [[rank insignia plaque]], which displayed two red squares over two blue squares. ==Behind the scenes== Grotton first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch|The Bad Batch]]'' [[The Bad Batch Season 2|Season 2]] episode "[[The Solitary Clone]]," which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[January 11]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} He was voiced by [[Max Mittelman]]. ==Appearances== *{{TBB|The Solitary Clone}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|R15uYFpeBG0|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season 2 | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/season-2-official-trailer-star-wars-the-bad-batch}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} *{{SW|url=news/dee-bradley-baker-cody-the-bad-batch|text=''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'': Dee Bradley Baker on the Return of Commander Cody – Exclusive}} {{Imo}} *{{InsiderCite|219|Star Wars: The Bad Batch: The Anatomy of Animation|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'': The Anatomy of Animation Part I}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|governor-grotton|Governor Grotton}} *{{Databank|tawni-ames|Tawni Ames}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Grotton |fr=Grotton |ja=グロットン |ka=გროტონი }} [[Category:Governors of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
